verdict.rationale: Mastercard publishes a public GitHub repo, open-banking-us-openapi, whose test project generates an API client library from the API specification. That shows the product ships a machine-readable spec that can be obtained and used for code generation. The MCP toolkit also references "current API specifications", but the evidence never explicitly documents a download location or confirms the spec format and version. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs naming a downloadable OpenAPI file/URL, confirmation of the spec format and that it is current and complete for all Open Finance endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The test project generates an API client library from the API specification like you would do in a real application
Generate accurate, working code examples based on current API specifications
